title: Silicone stretch lids
text: Silicone stretch lids. Silicone stretch lids - these wash up great in the dishwasher and stretch over bowls of most sizes.  I think they work best with glass in my opinion.  So far, I like them.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All of my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I am not influenced by any outside source. I receive/accept NO free products or discounts that are not available to all shoppers- ever. For some reason our shopper ranks are no longer visible - so, to give you a little more info about me, I am a top 50 reviewer (#30 the highest rank achieved). product_metadata.title: unwasted Reusable Silicone Lids – Versatile Freezer to Microwave Cover for Food – Leak-Proof Silicone Stretch Lids for 9” - 12” Container, Bowl, or Cup – Dishwasher Safe Silicone Bowl Covers transparent XX-Large, 2 Pack (Set of 2)
features: Our unwasted story: Just like you, we were looking for easy, convenient storage solutions to keep food & drinks fresh or replace lids; a sustainable alternative to the rolls & rolls of single-use plastic wrap, aluminum foil, or other harmful plastics that end up in landfills and our oceans. These reusable silicone lids were created to help you do your little bit for the planet, and save you money, time and energy!

The Original Stretchy Lid: unwasted created these clear reusable bowl covers in 2017 to be a universal lid set with an airtight, leak-proof seal to keep your food fresh for longer. An alternative to single-use plastic wrap, a bowl with our eco lids can be turned upside down and will not spill. We perfected the design to be easy to use, long lasting and just the right amount of stretch.

Cut Wasted Plastic, Food & Time: Find the size you need quickly and store your meal prep, groceries & leftovers for days. Avoid cross contamination by using Unwasted silicone lids for bowls and food covers with an airtight seal. This universal unwasted lid set has 7 different sizes, from Small to XL lid for square dishes, rectangle casserole trays, large bowls or even a lemon.

Everyone Needs Eco Storage Solutions: unwasted silicone covers for food storage come in a quality, recyclable cardboard box. We included a 100% cotton mesh bag for storage for the stacked lids when not in use. Our high quality materials don’t hold a smell even with leftover soups, pastas & more.

unwasted transparent XX-Large, 2 Pack BPA Free, Microwave, Oven, Freezer & Dishwasher Safe: This sustainable microwave unwasted lid cover for food can be used from the microwave to the freezer without warping, melting, or releasing any harmful chemicals. The material for our reusable kitchen lids is Platinum cured, food grade silicone that is BPA free, Lead Free, Phthalate Free & Plastic Free.
